summary.headline: Horizon Industrial Parks Q2 FY27 revenue rose 30% YoY to INR213 crore, EBITDA INR173 crore at 81% margin, net debt cut to INR2,765 crore.
summary.overview: Q2 FY27 was the company's strongest quarter to date, with revenue of about INR213 crore (up 30% YoY) and EBITDA of INR173 crore (up 34%). Net debt fell to INR2,765 crore at September-end from INR4,967 crore at June-end after post-IPO repayments. H1 leasing reached 4.4 million sq ft, about two-thirds of the 6.5 million sq ft FY27 target, and H1 development completions reached 2.7 million sq ft against a 6 million sq ft target. Management said the company is on track for targets and expects the in-city Pune asset to deliver and sign its first lease this quarter.

financial_highlights.change: Q2 pro forma cash PAT stated as nearly INR130 crore

financial_highlights.value: Positive (company said it is 'in black' on reported basis)
INR635 crore facility refinanced, 71 bps reduction in borrowing cost

financial_highlights.change: CS debt about 100 bps over LRD rate

segments.name: Large format parks
segments.commentary: Stabilised portfolio occupancy 94%; re-leasing of 1.2 million sq ft in H1 at a 12% spread; 5% contractual escalations; weighted average rent about INR27/sq ft, with new big-format leasing at INR30-35/sq ft.

segments.name: In-city developments
segments.commentary: Nine in-city assets under development, to deliver over the next 8-10 quarters; target about 6 million sq ft over 3-4 years at rents 2-3x big-format parks; first multi-story Pune asset to deliver by Q4 FY27 / Q1 CY27, currently contributing negligible revenue.

segments.name: Rooftop solar / value-added services
segments.commentary: About 38 MW operational or under implementation; planned 10 MW rooftop open-access project at about INR4.25 crore/MW (INR42-43 crore), with management citing IRR above 20%; management sees value-added services at 5-10% of future revenue.

guidance_outlook: FY27 leasing target of 6.5 million sq ft (30% above FY26); two-thirds achieved by end of H1 (4.4 million sq ft across 27 transactions).
FY27 development target of 6 million sq ft; H1 completions 2.7 million sq ft; operational area to rise to nearly 35 million sq ft by year-end.
Contracted revenue guidance of INR1,004 crore, based on 94% stabilised occupancy plus a couple of million sq ft of pre-commitments to be delivered over the next 3-4 quarters.
Expects embedded growth of 7-8% from escalations plus re-leasing; the INR125 crore incremental revenue from H1 leasing is the basis for the run-rate increase.
Expects the first in-city lease to be signed in Q3 FY27 and the first multi-story in-city asset to launch with pre-commitments in H2.
Interest cost savings are expected to be visible mainly from Q3 onward, with H1 impact described as negligible.
capex_capacity: Land bank is fully paid and supports about 29-30 million sq ft of future development; construction financing and approvals are largely in place.
Build cycle is 6-9 months once land development is complete; speculative build now about two-thirds of the 6 million sq ft FY27 target, with pre-commitments of 1.5-2 million sq ft.
Operational area about 31.5 million sq ft at Q2 versus 28.5 million sq ft at March 2026.
Rooftop solar: about 38 MW operational or under implementation, versus a roof potential of 150-200 MW; management said only about 40 MW has been achieved so far on the 30 million sq ft platform.
Acquisition engine to restart in the next one to two quarters; raw material land bank covers the next 4-5 years.
demand_pricing: Industrial customers account for about 80% of H1 leasing; 27 new leases in H1, of which about 10 were with existing customers and 17 new customers onboarded.
Q2 leasing was 2.5 million sq ft across 14 transactions, with 8 new customers; over 40% of Q2 leasing came from existing customers.
Lease expiries: about 0.7-0.8 million sq ft in the remainder of FY27 and just over 2 million sq ft in FY28; weighted average remaining lease tenure about 6.5 years.
Management expects Q3 to be seasonally slower due to festivities and the global shutdown from mid-December to early January.
In-city demand is coming from a wider set of industries than quick commerce, dark stores and cloud kitchens alone.
Stabilised occupancy fell to 94% from about 95% as the denominator grew with new deliveries; management said business fundamentals had not materially changed.

qa_highlights.question: Is H1 seasonally stronger for leasing, and could the FY27 leasing target be upgraded? What about the industrial versus warehousing mix?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said demand is now diversified and less cyclical than in the past, with about 80% of H1 leasing from industrial customers. Q3 typically slows due to festivals and global shutdowns, but demand is not disappearing.

qa_highlights.question: Pimpri in-city asset: what tenant type and rentals are being discussed?
qa_highlights.answer: Details are confidential; management expects to disclose after signing. Rent is guided at 2-3x big-format parks, roughly INR60-90/sq ft depending on location, with demand from a wider range of industries.

qa_highlights.question: Status of the CWC litigation and downside risk?
qa_highlights.answer: The matter remains sub judice, with no significant update since the Jan 2026 hearing. The court has said it will not stop development in the interim, and management continues construction.

qa_highlights.question: What is the committed occupancy on the 31.5 million sq ft operational area, and how much of the INR1,000 crore run rate is already generating rent?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said stabilised occupancy is 94% after excluding about 1 million sq ft of recent completions held as stock in trade. The INR1,004 crore contracted revenue is based on this 94% occupancy plus a couple of million sq ft of pre-commitments.

qa_highlights.question: How will interest costs trend after deleveraging, and what is the interest saving?
qa_highlights.answer: Debt of about INR4,000 crore was repaid at the back end of Q2, so the impact was negligible in Q2 and fuller benefit comes later. Cost of debt is about 8.2%, and pro forma H1 cash generation is INR240-250 crore after interest and depreciation adjustments.

qa_highlights.question: Same-store occupancy declined: why, and what is the rent per sq ft on new leasing?
qa_highlights.answer: The decline reflects the larger denominator from new deliveries (about 1 million sq ft of stock in trade), not a material business change. Based on H1 leasing of 3.2 million sq ft new and 1.2 million sq ft re-leased, the company estimates INR125 crore of incremental revenue; weighted average rent is about INR27/sq ft.

qa_highlights.question: Solar capacity plans and economics for rooftop solar?
qa_highlights.answer: About 38 MW is operational or under implementation, with a 10 MW rooftop open-access project planned at about INR4.25 crore/MW. Management cited an IRR above 20% (18-20% yield in another answer) and said regulatory support is needed for larger scale.

risks_watch: CWC litigation remains sub judice; no hearing since Jan 2026 and outcome is uncertain.
Q3 seasonality could slow leasing closures (Diwali, global shutdown).
Stabilised occupancy slipped to 94% from about 95%; monitor the lease-up of about 1 million sq ft of stock in trade and the 0.7-0.8 million sq ft of expiries in H2 FY27.
Achieving the 6 million sq ft development target and first in-city lease in Q3 FY27 depends on execution.
Rooftop solar scale-up depends on regulatory approval for open access; the company said it cannot yet give a timeline.
Refinancing of remaining CS debt (about 100 bps above the LRD rate) is still to be executed; management said it is exploring banks.
summary.management_tone: Confident and upbeat on demand, leasing momentum and balance-sheet repair. Management was guarded on litigation and in-city rents, saying details are confidential, and on solar scale, saying it needs regulatory support. Some answers were long and not fully responsive, and the Q2 growth split was not disclosed on the call.
key_quotes: Q2 has been our strongest quarter to date with record revenue and EBITDA.
We truly believe this is only the beginning.
We are very, very confident that we will continue to that this will play out positively in our favor.
Even if you look at our second quarter results or the first half results put together, nearly 80% of the demand has come from the industrial customers.

growth.why: Management reiterated FY27 leasing target of 6.5 mn sq ft (4.4 mn done in H1) and 6 mn sq ft completions (2.7 mn in H1), backed by 1,004 cr contracted revenue run-rate, a couple of mn sq ft of pre-commitments and ~1.5-2 mn sq ft pre-commitments on speculative build, with a land bank for 29-30 mn sq ft, but in-city and Pune deliveries are later and the revenue growth % is not guided.
